title: When a piece of childhood peels away. Forever time only leaves fruits of forgotten moments growing on trees in the Wood of Never Was #smallpoems
summary: When a piece of childhood peels away. Forever time only leaves fruits of forgotten moments growing on trees in the Wood of Never Was #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
When
a piece
of childhood
peels
away.

Forever

time only
leaves
fruits of
forgotten
  moments
growing on
  trees in the
Wood of Never Was

#smallpoems
